extracted.intended_audience: education professionals, donors, partner organisations, and policymakers interested in media literacy projects in Palestine
extracted.subtask_short: media literacy education project in Palestine
extracted.subtask_description: A multi-year (2023–2026) development project to embed media literacy into Bethlehem University's curriculum, strengthen teachers' pedagogical skills, run student courses, and carry out community media-literacy initiatives in Palestinian territories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embed media literacy into Bethlehem University curriculum
rubrics_metrics.description: The aim is to support the inclusion of media literacy as an integral part of the university curriculum at Bethlehem University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the project's central objective because media literacy is currently not included in the Palestinian national curriculum and is barely included in university education. Embedding implies curricular adoption and institutionalisation rather than one-off workshops.

rubrics_metrics.name: Train 28 teachers and trainers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target number specified for 2023–2026. In the first year (2023–2024) the aim was to arrange continuing education for teachers at Bethlehem University. Training is intended to strengthen pedagogical skills and may involve Finnish volunteer trainers (journalists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage 80 journalism students in courses
rubrics_metrics.description: To encourage 80 journalism students to participate in media literacy courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric participation target; implementation involves offering critical media literacy courses for journalism students at the university in cooperation with Finnish volunteer trainers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organise 30 community projects using media literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: To organise 30 community projects drawing on media literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community projects will be carried out in rural communities around Bethlehem and Hebron (geographic focus). These projects aim to translate classroom learning into community-level activities and participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen pedagogical skills of university teachers
rubrics_metrics.description: To strengthen the pedagogical skills of the university’s teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities include continuing education and teacher training modules; this is linked to successful curricular integration and sustainable teaching of media literacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement critical media literacy courses for journalism students
rubrics_metrics.description: To implement a critical media literacy course for journalism students at the university in cooperation with Finnish volunteer trainers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on critical approaches to media literacy tailored to journalism education; volunteer trainers are journalists, implying practitioner-led instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen community participation in Palestinian territories
rubrics_metrics.description: To strengthen community participation in the Palestinian territories through media literacy and education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community participation is both an outcome and a mechanism for democratic engagement; projects target rural communities to broaden civic engagement beyond urban centres.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote right to information and active citizenship
rubrics_metrics.description: To promote the local population’s right to information and to strengthen active citizenship and the prerequisites for democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are intended higher-level societal outcomes of the project—media literacy is framed as support for democratic prerequisites rather than solely technical skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce and distribute teaching materials (English & Arabic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide materials such as the 'Media Literacy Toolbox – Exercises for teaching media literacy' available in English and Arabic; publish a new Media Guide (focusing on media education in the areas of tension) by autumn 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials are bilingual (English and Arabic) and include exercises for teaching. A further Media Guide is planned for publication in autumn 2026, indicating ongoing resource development and contextual focus (areas of tension).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project timeline and implementation period
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets and activities (teacher training, student courses, community projects, publications) are expected within this multi-year timeframe; first-year emphasis on teacher continuing education and course implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding and co-financing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Funded by Finland’s development cooperation appropriations for NGOs (€453,457 for 2023–2026) with additional self-financing (including volunteer work) of about €80,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project budgeting includes donor funding plus significant self-financing/volunteer contributions; funder attribution and disclaimer about views not representing the Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs are noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local partnership and coordination
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinator: The Finnish Lifelong Learning Foundation; Partner: Institute for Community Partnership (ICP) at Bethlehem University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project structure requires a local institutional partner (ICP) and an international coordinator. Successful implementation implies active collaboration between coordinator, local partner, volunteers, and beneficiaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of journalists as volunteer trainers
rubrics_metrics.description: Volunteers involved in teaching are journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trainer background is practitioner-focused, suggesting courses and trainings are led by experienced media professionals rather than solely academics; this may shape pedagogical approach and course content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic focus on rural communities around Bethlehem and Hebron
rubrics_metrics.description: Community projects will be carried out in rural communities around Bethlehem and Hebron.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies target locations for outreach; indicates an emphasis on reaching rural populations rather than only urban centres.
